title: Dynamic Arm Circles & Shoulder Rolls
instructions: Stand tall, rotate arms in 15-second forward circles followed by backward circles.
benefits: Lubricates subacromial shoulder joints prior to upper body resistance training.

title: Seated Hamstring & Calf Static Stretch
instructions: Sit on floor with legs extended, reach gently toward toes holding for 30 seconds without bouncing.
benefits: Reduces post-workout lactic acid buildup and prevents hamstring tightness.
